verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a first-party Webhook integration that sends outbound HTTP requests. Those requests carry a Honeybadger-Token verification header, and a newer bearer-token field lets programmatic consumers such as Cursor Automations receive them. Integrations let users choose which error events trigger notifications, so subscribing to events via webhooks is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: webhook payload schema and event-type catalog documentation, dedicated webhook setup docs in the pack, independent/hands-on corroboration.
